236: The true story of pianist Władysław Szpilman's experiences in Warsaw during the Nazi occupation. Music was his passion. Survival was his masterpiece.
492: In year 1250 B.C. during the late Bronze age, two emerging nations begin to clash. Paris, the Trojan prince, convinces Helen, Queen of Sparta, to leave her husband Menelaus, and sail with him back to Troy. They set off with 1,000 ships holding 50,000 Greeks to Troy.
For passion. For honor. For destiny. For victory. For love.
748: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.
A look that led to an evening. A mistake he'll regret... FOR THE REST OF HIS LIFE.
1004: It's the battle of wills, as Andie needs to prove she can dump a guy in 10 days, whereas Ben needs to prove he can win a girl in 10 days. Now, the clock is ticking—and the wildly entertaining comedy smash is off and running in this irresistible tale of sex, lies and outrageous romantic fireworks!
One of them is lying. So is the other.
1260: Superman returns to discover his 5-year absence has allowed Lex Luthor to walk free, and that those he was closest to felt abandoned and have moved on. Luthor plots his ultimate revenge that could see millions killed and change the face of the planet forever, as well as ridding himself of the Man of Steel.
1516: Vampire housemates try to cope with the complexities of modern life and show a newly turned hipster some of the perks of being undead.
1772: Portland, Oregon, 1971. Bob Hughes is the charismatic leader of a peculiar quartet, formed by his wife, Dianne, and another couple, Rick and Nadine, who skillfully steal from drugstores and hospital medicine cabinets in order to appease their insatiable need for drugs. But neither fun nor luck last forever.
Sooner or later, someone will pay the price.
2028: A mysterious spacecraft captures Russian and American space capsules and brings the two superpowers to the brink of war. James Bond investigates the case in Japan and comes face to face with his archenemy Blofeld.
...and "twice" is the only way to live!
2284: A Marine Colonel is brought to court-martial after ordering his men to fire on demonstrators surrounding the American embassy in Yemen.
A hero should never have to stand alone.
2540: Questions arise when Senator Stoddard attends the funeral of a local man named Tom Doniphon in a small Western town. 2796: A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.
Life's too short to be a background character.
3052: When principal Joe Clark takes over decaying Eastside High School, he's faced with students wearing gang colors and graffiti-covered walls. Eastside High was out of control...until Joe Clark took it back.
3308: In 1981 New York City, a collection of twentysomethings try to cope with relationships, loneliness, desire and their individual neuroses on New Years Eve.
It's 11:59 on New Years Eve... do you know where your date is?

They came from Paris, Rome, London and Berlin to… the Spanish Apartment… where a year can change a lifetime.
3820: Awkward teenager Charlie Bartlett has trouble fitting in at a new high school. He becomes one of the most popular guys in school by doling out advice and, occasionally, medication, to the student body.
Popularity is a state of mind.
4076: Hotshot gambler Jake Green is long on bravado and seriously short of common sense. Rarely is he allowed in any casino because he's a bona fide winner and, in fact, has taken so much money over the years that he's the sole client of his accountant elder brother, Billy. Invited to a private game, Jake is in fear of losing his life.
Your mind will not accept a game this big.
4332: In 1996, electric cars began to appear on roads all over California. They were quiet and fast, produced no exhaust, and ran without gasoline... Ten years later, these cars were destroyed.
A lack of consumer confidence... or conspiracy?
4588: A career criminal nabbed by Mexican authorities is placed in a tough prison where he learns to survive with the help of a 9-year-old boy.
The odds are against him. So is everyone else.

What was once in the deep is now in the shallows.

Every legend has a new beginning.
5356: Vincent LaMarca is a dedicated and well-respected New York City police detective who has gone to great lengths to distance himself from his past, but then makes the terrible discovery that his own son has fallen into a life of crime.
When you're searching for a killer... the last suspect you want to see is your son.
5612: Two friends hired to police a small town that is suffering under the rule of a rancher find their job complicated by the arrival of a young widow.

There's a reason we've never gone back to the moon.

6636: An action epic that explores the origins of the Aqua Teen Hunger Force (better known as Master Shake, Frylock, and Meatwad,) who somehow become pitted in a battle over an immortal piece of exercise equipment.
Meatwad / Carl / Ignignokt / Video Game Voice (voice)

They're giving dirty rotten men a run for their money.

Nobody believes a liar... even when they're telling the truth.
7916: After suffering a brutal defeat and being told he can no longer fight, 37-year-old, scar-ridden prizefighter Louis 'Mountain' Rivera struggles to find a new direction in life.
The world of Mountain Riviera... the fast buck... the angry men... the lonely woman!

They came… They saw… They panicked…
8940: When a group of tourists on a New Orleans haunted swamp tour find themselves stranded in the wilderness, their evening of fun and spooks turns into a horrific nightmare.

Dr. Elaine Keener (segments "This is Dr. Keener" and "Fantasies about Rebecca")
Christine Taylor (segments "Goodnight Lilly, Goodnight Christine" and "This is Dr. Keener")
Rose (segments "Someone For Rose" and "Fantasies about Rebecca")
Detective Kathy Faber (segment "Love Waits For Kathy")
Walter (segments "Fantasies About Rebecca" and "Love Waits For Kathy")

Some jobs really go for the throat.

9964: Ana, an eight-year-old girl living in Madrid with her grandmother and two sisters, mourns the death of her mother.
10220: A young man with Tourette's Syndrome embarks on a road trip with his recently-deceased mother's ashes.
On the road. But a little bit off.
10732: When experienced advertising executive Graham Marshall loses out on a promotion to a young man, he goes down in a path of vengeance.
Climbing the corporate ladder can be murder.

Hold on for the wildest ride of your life
12012: The film follows Finnish army machine gun company in Continuation War against Soviet Union, 1941–1944. Based on Väinö Linna's best selling novel Tuntematon Sotilas (The Unknown Soldier) and the novel's uncensored version, Sotaromaani (A War Novel).
Finland, behold, thy daylight now is dawning.
12524: A woman trapped in a home elevator is terrorized by a group of vicious hoodlums.
What happens in this elevator is not for the weak - it is, perhaps, not even for the strong!
George L. Brady Jr. aka Repent
12780: An obsessed cop is on the trail of a serial killer prowling the streets of Buffalo, N.Y. but when his teenage daughter disappears, he drops any professional restraint to get the killer.
13548: Two estranged brothers reunite at their missing father's video store to liquidate the property and sell off his assets. 13804: A former child art prodigy and second generation petty thief arranges to buy his way out of prison to spend time with his ailing son, only to be forced to alter his plans and commit one more job for the man who financed his release.

Erast also knows that there is a spy somewhere in the Russian army, everyone is under suspicion.
14316: A down on his luck cubicle worker and his slacker best friend discover their new boss is a vampire who is turning their coworkers into the un-dead.
Work. It sucks the life out of you.
14828: Celebrated sleuth Hercule Poirot, now retired and living in self-imposed exile in Venice, reluctantly attends a Halloween séance at a decaying, haunted palazzo. When one of the guests is murdered, the detective is thrust into a sinister world of shadows and secrets.

All the kids grow 10 feet tall... and TAKE OVER!
15596: A woman in her thirties gets tired of life in Paris and decides to leave and become a farmer.
15852: Standing on the precipice of adulthood, a group of friends navigate new relationships, while reexamining others, during their final summer before college.
Your real life is about to begin.
16108: During the Napoleonic Wars, when the French have occupied Spain, some Spanish guerrilla soldiers are going to move a big cannon across Spain in order to help the British defeat the French. A British officer is there to accompany the Spanish and along the way, he falls in love with the leader's girl.
You have never seen its like -- and may never see its equal!

16620: In this early film adaptation of the classic novel by Robert Louis Stevenson, young Jim Hawkins is caught up with the pirate Long John Silver in search of buccaneer Captain Flint's buried treasure.
Sail the high seas of adventure again!
17388: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.
He Fed Their Fears And Turned Neighbor Against Neighbor!
17644: When his grandmother takes ill, foolish brute Recep tries to satisfy her wishes by getting a job and attempting to find a suitable wife.
17900: Sabine vows to give up married lovers, and is determined to find a good husband. Her best friend Clarisse introduces her to her cousin Edmond, a busy lawyer from Paris. Sabine pursues Edmond, with the encouragement of Clarisse, but Edmond does not seem very interested.

18412: When Sawa's mother and policeman father are found victims of a grisly double homicide, she begins a ruthless pursuit for the man who murdered them. Never underestimate a girl with nothing to lose.

At their best, they're the worst.

When love blossoms between them, the two girls will be forced to choose between happiness and safety.
20204: The story of the five Russian hockey stars who helped the Detroit Red Wings win back-to-back Stanley Cup championships and created one of the most memorable chapters in Motor City sports history.
20972: Memo lives on a remote Chilean sheep farm, hiding a beautiful singing voice from the outside world. A recluse with a glittery flair, he can't stop dwelling on the past, but what will happen once someone finally listens?

23020: A young woman who has faded to the point of becoming invisible must find her way back with the help of the one man who can see her.
23532: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Bharat ko chhedoge, toh chhodenge nahi

24556: A young man from a remote village dreams of launching his own airline service. However, he must overcome several obstacles and challenges in order to be successful in his quest.
Dream so big, they call you crazy
24812: Accompanied by her closeted gay buddy, a promiscuous teenager sets out to find her long-absent father.
25068: Four best friends take their book club to Italy for the fun girls' trip they never had. When things go off the rails and secrets are revealed, their relaxing vacation turns into a once-in-a-lifetime cross-country adventure.

25580: A happy-go-lucky college student falls in love with a beautiful young woman at first sight, but decides to use a unique approach to get close to her, as she has many admirers in the college. How will their relationship evolve?

26348: The search for a child murderer drags a once-respected detective into an all-consuming obsession.

26860: During the Hyderabad Liberation Movement of 1948, there will be atrocities, like the episode of Gundrampally, Parkala, Bhairanpally villages.

Special Appearance in "Ek Toh Kum Zindagani" Song

Witches don't die before leaving their legacy...

28396: Alabama; 1969: The death of a clan's estranged wife and mother brings together two very different families. The scars of the past hide differences that will either tear them apart or expose truths that could lead to unexpected collisions.

In 2961: The only rule is instinct

Run. Fight. Survive. The hunt is on.
